samples.summary: Near-vacuous test: 'leaves an absent color key absent' re-uses the same input as the first case and asserts only that an unrelated key was not invented
samples.evidence: `it('leaves an absent color key absent — absent means "do not touch"')` calls `normalizeStyleClears({ backgroundColor: '' })` and asserts `'color' in result === false`. `normalizeStyleClears` (packages/docs/src/model/types.ts:277) only ever assigns keys that are already present with value `''`, so this assertion holds for the pre-change behaviour (returning the input untouched) and for essentially any plausible regression. It also duplicates the input of the test at line 116, adding no new state. The stated intent ("absent means do not touch" downstream, i.e. that `applyInlineStyle`/`styleByPath` leave an unmentioned key alone) is not exercised at all here.

samples.summary: The Yorkie-side regression tests only cover a whole-block range, so the re-merge behaviour the comment cites as the bug is not asserted in the Tree
samples.evidence: Both new tests style and then clear the full range `0..5` of a single-inline block, so the Tree never contains split neighbour runs. The test comment claims the defect is that "the run can never re-merge with its neighbours", but nothing asserts inline count in the CRDT after a partial-range clear (e.g. apply `backgroundColor` to 1..3, then clear 1..3, expect the block to collapse back to one inline). The docs-package test covers merge only in the in-memory helper (packages/docs/test/store/block-helpers.test.ts:234-241), not in `applyStyleInTree`'s split/cleanup path (packages/frontend/src/app/docs/yorkie-doc-store.ts:1889-1901).

samples.summary: No test covers the collapsed-caret / pending-style path with an empty-string color
samples.evidence: `applyStyleImpl` stores `{ ...getSelectionStyleImpl(), ...style }` into the pending style when there is no selection (packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:999-1006), and `createPendingStyle.set` copies it verbatim (packages/docs/src/view/pending-style.ts:22-24). A picker's `''` therefore lives in the pending style and is read back by `getSelectionStyle` for toolbar state; no test in the diff or the tree exercises 'clear highlight with a collapsed caret, then type'. Searched for pendingStyle/applyStyle tests across packages/docs/test and packages/frontend/tests.
searchedFor: grep backgroundColor: '' / color: '' repo-wide (only the three new test files matched)

samples.summary: Identity assertion (`toBe(style)`) pins an implementation detail rather than behaviour
samples.evidence: `expect(normalizeStyleClears(style)).toBe(style)` fails if the function is ever changed to always return a copy, even though the observable normalization behaviour would be identical. `toEqual` plus a key-set check would express the intent (nothing changed) without coupling to the no-copy optimization.
